title: feat(spec)!: retire a page header's breadcrumb switch — no renderer draws a trail for it (#20758)
body:
Closes #20758

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

`PageHeaderProps.breadcrumb` retires through the ADR-0087 route, the way `icon` left the same row. It has a `retiredKey()` tombstone, the D2 conversion `page-header-breadcrumb-removed` (it strips `true` and `false` from stored and built pages with a notice, retired from the load path), the `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` entry and the D3 entry `page-header-breadcrumb-retired`. A stored page is never refused for the key: the props lint reports it as a warning.

`nav:breadcrumb` stays, because objectui's Studio page palette writes it.

The published skill `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` stops teaching the key (two lines). That path is governed, so this PR lands Tier H, after an authorized approval.

`@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING.
